{{Quote|In recognition of your excellent droid building skills, we present to you this certificate aknowledging you as a Master Droid Builder.|Wimateeka to the Rebel agent|<ref name="Star Wars: DroidWorks">''[[Star Wars: DroidWorks]]''</ref>}}
A '''droid builder''' was an individual who designed and assembled [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. Such individuals, depending on their degree of skills, could hold the tile of Apprentice, Designer, or Master Droid Builder. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Wimateeka]] of the [[Nkik clan]] was a renowned droid builder. He taught his skills to a [[Unidentified Rebel agent (droid builder)|Rebel agent]], who earned a [[Jawa droid builder certificate]].
